card.name: Spaces and digits before years
card.fires_on: Mostly the space or digit just before a year (April 2011, 1937, March 1933) and small words like 'the' or 'of' in passages about government manuals and directories. Also 'menu' in text about GUI menus.

modes.label: Before a year
modes.description: The space or a digit inside a year number, right after a month name or 'In 19'.

modes.label: Linking words in manual and directory text
modes.description: Small words like 'the', 'of' or 'and' in text about handbooks, manuals and web directories.
